runtime.name: Luau CLI
runtime.version: 0.747 (release tag/commit and official asset digest pinned in PHASE3_MANIFOLD_LUAU_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTIC_20261119.md)

sweep.oracle: independent convex projection onto intersection of normal halfspaces for multi-contact; closed-form restitution response for one contact

compatibilityProbe.result: The module returns success with zero residual for exact opposite multi-contact normals because it assigns zero target to all contacts. It does not test the incompatible restitution targets that would otherwise be implied by the supplied restitution fields.

scopeLimitations: This tests the PGS normal-velocity kernel, not position correction, TOI, geometry generation, or physical collision timing.
Multi-contact restitution is intentionally set to zero by current prototype; e variation is effective for single-contact cases but not in multi-contact cases.
No TOI integration or physical/Roblox test was performed.
The velocity error field for failed solver cases compares the uncommitted candidate to the projection oracle and is not a committed state error.
The logged max successful oracle error is a floating-point/tolerance comparison; residual tolerance is 1e-8.
